question: Let $C = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9 \end{bmatrix}$. Compute all the minors and cofactors of the second row. Then, expand $|C|$ along the second row and check whether the result matches the direct expansion of $|C|$.
explanation:
Second row elements: $4,5,6$

Minors:
$M_{21}:$ Remove row 2, col 1: $\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\8&9\end{vmatrix}=2*9-3*8=18-24=-6$

$M_{22}:$ Remove row 2, col 2: $\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\7&9\end{vmatrix}=1*9-3*7=9-21=-12$

$M_{23}:$ Remove row 2, col 3: $\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\7&8\end{vmatrix}=1*8-2*7=8-14=-6$

Cofactors:
$A_{21}= -1*M_{21}=6$ (since $(-1)^{2+1}=-1$)
$A_{22}=+1*M_{22}=-12$
$A_{23}=-1*M_{23}=6$

Expansion:
$|C|=4*6+5*(-12)+6*6=24-60+36=0$

Directly, $|C|$ is the determinant of $C$

$1\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\8&9\end{vmatrix}-2\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\7&9\end{vmatrix}+3\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\7&8\end{vmatrix}$
First: $5*9-6*8=45-48=-3$
Second: $4*9-6*7=36-42=-6$, so $-2*-6=12$
Third: $4*8-5*7=32-35=-3$, $3*-3=-9$
$=1*-3+12-9=-3+12-9=0$

Both expansions give $|C|=0$.

options.D: $M_{21}=-6$, $M_{22}=-12$, $M_{23}=-6$; cofactors are $6,-12,6$ and expansion along the second row gives $|C|=0$, matching direct expansion.
